summary: Tears down a fixed-block memory pool guarded by cleanup flag byte_8AB6E0 bit 0 (set on entry to prevent double-free). Walks the free list headed by dword_8AB700 and the active list headed by dword_8AB6F0, freeing each node's buffer pointer when the in-use flag byte at node+8 is set, then freeing the node struct itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Resets all free-list (dword_8AB700/dword_8AB704/dword_8AB708/dword_8AB70C) and active-list (dword_8AB6F0/dword_8AB6F4/dword_8AB6F8/dword_8AB6FC) pointers to zero. Returns 1 regardless of whether the guard skipped the teardown.

local_names.v3: bool: in-use flag byte at node+8 is zero
local_names.v6: buffer pointer stored at active-list node +0

operations.description: Re-entry guard on byte_8AB6E0 bit 0: when already set, skip the entire teardown; otherwise set bit 0 and proceed (prevents double-free).

Walk the free list from head dword_8AB700 following the next link at node+4; when the in-use flag byte at node+8 is non-zero, free the node's buffer pointer (*v2) with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and the loop's update frees the node itself (v2) each iteration.
Reset the free-list globals to zero: head dword_8AB700, dword_8AB704, dword_8AB708, and count dword_8AB70C.

Walk the active list from head dword_8AB6F0 following the next link at node+4; for nodes with the in-use flag byte at +8 non-zero and a non-null buffer pointer at +0, free the buffer pointed to by the node's buffer pointer and then the buffer pointer struct itself with FreeWrapper_7bcf; the loop's update frees the node itself (v5) each iteration.
Reset the active-list globals to zero: head dword_8AB6F0, dword_8AB6F4, dword_8AB6F8, and count dword_8AB6FC.
Return 1 both on the guarded early path and after the full teardown.
